subject: The Premium feature that bypasses Turnitin
body_paragraphs: You've been using Thesis Generator for a couple of weeks now. You've probably generated thesis statements, maybe a few outlines. But here's the feature most free users don't know exists: Humanize.

The free version generates thesis statements and outlines. Premium adds one critical thing — the Humanize button. It rewrites AI-generated text in a way that bypasses Turnitin, GPTZero, Originality, and every other AI detector. We tested it on 1,247 papers. The bypass rate is 99.2%. That's not a typo.

If you're submitting AI-assisted work right now, you're risking detection on every paper you turn in. Premium's Humanize button rewrites the same content in a natural, undetectable voice. It's the difference between hoping you don't get flagged and knowing you won't.

The Premium trial is 7 days, fully free, run as many essays through Humanize as you want. P.S. We tested the bypass on five detectors: Turnitin, Originality.ai, GPTZero, ZeroGPT, and Copyleaks. All five passed.
